entry.title: C++26: Module improvements
entry.summary: C++20 introduced modules as a - potential - fundamental shift in how we organize and consume C++ code. Sadly, the adoption has been slow — build system support lagged, compiler implementations were incomplete and diverging, and some of the original design decisions created unnecessary friction.
